ValidationRule.description: Config is upserted between orgs on this external id. Renaming makes the next import insert a duplicate card instead of updating this one, and the tab then renders both. ISCHANGED is false on insert, so this fires only on update.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A card's developer name cannot change: configuration is upserted between orgs on it, so renaming would duplicate this card on the next deployment. Change the label instead.
